articles.title: Petrol prices could have hit Rs 125/Litre without ethanol blending, says Govt
articles.description: Defending the Ethanol Blended Petrol (EBP) Programme against criticism over costs and food security, the Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas stated on Friday that retail petrol prices in Delhi could have surged to around ₹125 per litre during peak global crude oil spikes if India had not implemented ethanol blending.
